Oh, won't you please take one?
They're really weighing me down.

Oh, did you change your mind? Great!
You can have your choice of Fossils!

Trainer! You still can't move ahead
'cause there is so much sand!{VAR BE01}
I will do my best to remove the sand.
Give me a second!

There! The sand is cleared away, so now
you can proceed.
